PE1-13.hint: Read the domain from left to right and the range from bottom to top. "Interior" means not at an endpoint. Increasing and decreasing are described with \(x\)-intervals, read left to right.
slips: Giving the \(y\)-value when the question asks for the \(x\)-location, or the reverse.
Reporting an endpoint as a local minimum or maximum. Interior extrema exclude the endpoints.

PE1-14.hint: Read the domain from left to right and the range from bottom to top, including the endpoints. "Interior" means not at an endpoint.
slips: Giving the \(y\)-value when the question asks for the \(x\)-location, or the reverse.
Taking the range from the endpoints only. The range runs from the lowest point to the highest point on the whole graph.
Describing increasing and decreasing intervals with \(y\)-values. They are intervals of \(x\).
